english.note: Use this more formal or general term for the place someone regards as their native home.

exampleSentences.english: I have always missed my hometown.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 gaa1 hoeng1

english.note: Use this for one's native land or hometown rather than the house one currently lives in.

exampleSentences.english: When I retire, I'll go back home to live in my hometown.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 teoi3 jau1 zau6 faan1 gaa1 hoeng1 zyu6
